skill_route.resolution: The mission-approved production registry entry and TC-FF6-MACH-001 bind complete ProductContract obligation slices to format-feature-expansion. The historical reconciler's depth-complete label was rejected because the source only exposed limited index-based mutations.

requested_operation: implement stable-ID cell insert, move, copy, replace, remove, combined search, and bulk removal with atomic validation, deterministic change reports, dry-run behavior, and save/reload stability

inputs.root_cause: The existing document exposed add_cell, remove_cell, and clear_outputs by numeric index plus a limited search helper. It had no stable-ID move/copy/replace lifecycle, no metadata query, no bulk change report, and no dry-run or atomic post-edit validation. Presence-based reconciliation nevertheless marked the capability complete.
inputs.affected_layer: IPYNB pure model editing, public API, preservation guarantees, save/reload behavior, and package documentation

observations: The failure-first test could not collect because format_factory.ipynb exported no CellEditOperation or governed editor.
The first implementation then failed 3 of 10 focused tests: its cell-list validation built a detached list, so reports claimed applied changes while the document remained unchanged.
The implementation was repaired to validate and return the owned list itself; the expanded 16-test matrix now compares every dry run with its applied operation and save/reload result.

implementation.compatibility: Existing IpynbDocument.add_cell, remove_cell, clear_outputs, and find_cells behavior is unchanged; edit_cells is an additive pre-1.0 lifecycle.
implementation.targeting: Mutations resolve required unique schema-valid cell IDs and reject missing, duplicate, or invalid IDs before changing state.
implementation.crud: Insert, replace, remove, move, and copy operate on deep-copied notebook state. Replace preserves the selected ID; copy generates deterministic collision-free IDs unless an explicit ID is supplied.
implementation.search: CellQuery combines ID, cell type, tag, recursive metadata subset, and logical source-text criteria.
implementation.bulk_safety: remove_where returns one ordered change per removed cell and refuses a query without a meaningful criterion, including an empty metadata mapping.
implementation.atomicity: Each candidate notebook is validated through the declared-profile validator before the original document is committed. Validation or selection failure leaves the document unchanged.
implementation.dry_run: Every mutation executes against the same isolated candidate and returns an equivalent immutable report without committing.
implementation.roundtrip: All six mutation classes are serialized and loaded through the production lifecycle with stable cell IDs and exact semantic state.
implementation.forward_preservation: An unrelated move in a future-minor notebook preserves unknown cell types and nested vendor fields unchanged.
implementation.tradeoff: Each mutation deep-copies and validates the complete notebook, making single edits O(document bytes). This provides atomicity and preservation safety; high-volume consumers should prefer the implemented bulk operation rather than repeated single removals.
